importantNotes: The doxology (vv. 24-25) is one of the most beautiful benedictions in Scripture.
Jude planned to write about salvation but was compelled to warn about false teachers instead.
Jude references non-biblical Jewish traditions (the Book of Enoch, the dispute over Moses' body).
'Contend for the faith once delivered to the saints' (v. 3) — the faith has fixed content.
Jude and 2 Peter share similar themes and content — likely aware of each other.

chapters.1: Contend for the faith; judgment on false teachers; build yourselves up in faith; the glorious doxology.
